title: GoThru Street Builder Marketing FE Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #5: Integrate Countly analytics for page views and installer downloads
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Integrate the Countly Web SDK into the StreetBuilder static/pre-rendered site.

Requirements

  • Use Countly server: https://data.gothru.org
  • Load the self-hosted SDK from https://data.gothru.org/sdk/web/countly.min.js
  • Enable analytics only on streetbuilder.co and www.streetbuilder.co
  • Track sessions and normalized page views, including SPA/history navigation
  • Track installer link clicks using the event key installer_download
  • Include segmentation: platform, architecture, version, and page_path
  • Support macOS arm64 and x86_64; report Windows as x86_64
  • Do not add automatic click, error, user, or PII tracking
  • Allow normal page behavior if the Countly SDK fails to load
  • Add the shared analytics script to every rendered HTML document exactly once

Acceptance criteria

  • Analytics remains disabled outside the two production hostnames
  • Initial load records a session and page view
  • SPA route changes record deduplicated, normalized page views
  • All three current installer links record the expected platform, architecture, version, and path
  • Unrelated links do not produce installer events
  • SDK load failure does not break the page
  • Automated tests cover the integration

Implementation note

Implement this using a shared script rather than modifying compiled Angular bundles.

issues.display_title: Issue #7: Integrate API Latest Release Street Builder
issues.main_description_html:
Description

This task integrates a dynamic fetch of the latest Street Builder release using the GitHub API (https://api.github.com/repos/GoThruMedia/gothru-street-builder/releases/latest).

  • Dynamic Download Links: Removed hardcoded download links in index.html.
  • Automatic Version Detection: Added a JavaScript snippet at the end of the <body> to fetch the latest release payload.
  • Platform Specific Selection: The script parses the assets list to automatically assign the correct URLs for:
    • Windows (.exe files, specifically targeting setup installers)
    • Mac ARM64 (arm64 packages)
    • Mac x86_64 (x86_64 packages)
  • Robust Regex Matching: The logic uses flexible regex patterns to ensure that version numbers in the filenames (e.g., Setup.1.2.14.exe) are correctly matched and set as the download links for the user.
